payload.title: Implement the query iteration surface (sessions, messages, parts)
payload.description:
**Files:** `src/store/query.rs` (new), `src/store/mod.rs`, `src/lib.rs` (re-exports), `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `01_iteration.feature` — remove its @wip (cross-source session iteration; in-order messages; in-order parts).

**Acceptance:** `Store::query() -> Query`: `sessions()` lazy iterator (last activity desc, id tiebreak — the chapter-1 order); `open(id)` materializes one session (serde round-trip from rows; `UnknownSession` for unknown ids, never a silent empty); `messages(id)` and per-message parts iterators streaming in ordinal order. Iteration counters (opens / rows fetched) exposed for spec observability exactly like the importer protocol's `peak_buffered`/`SkipCounter` precedent. Iterators are prepared-statement cursors from day one — laziness is inherent; its epic only proves it. Engine invisible: no rusqlite types, SQL strings, or vec0 names in public signatures.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
